subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

 'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B'

 'A – B' means 'A is the brother of B'

 'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B'

 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'

 Based on the above, how is M related to Q if 'M ÷ N – O + P × Q'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png]

Given Expression: M ÷ N – O + P × Q

M ÷ N: M is the father of N.

N – O: N is the brother of O.

O + P: O is the sister of P.

P × Q: P is the wife of Q.

According to the given information Family Tree Representation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5988769734a6f39504e25f98d2a308d3be919a9d74defef8f2c40f7e49daf41.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee9ceef1cf8c87f22a209d73903e97863a9664499e9e4028c816538eebc6af73.png] 

Therefore, M is the **Wife's Father** (Father-in-law) of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
